metadata.title: Infinitesimal Hilbertianity for manifolds with Sobolev regular Riemannian metrics through uniform lower capacity bounds
metadata.abstract: We prove that metric measure spaces arising from $2$-manifolds equipped with Riemannian metrics $g$ such that $g, g^{-1} \in L^\infty_{\rm loc} \cap W^{1,p}_{\rm loc}$ are infinitesimally Hilbertian. Along the way, we establish uniform lower $1$-capacity bounds of several $1$-dimensional subsets of $\R^2$.
